$comment: German typography as macOS de writes it: „…“ primary (806 hits across the pile's Finder/AppKit/System Settings strings, for example „%@“), ‚…‘ nested (AppKit NSSpellChecker 200510.title), the ’ apostrophe (geht’s). Schema: docs/i18n/termbase.md § <tag>/mechanics.json schema.

spacing.why: a space goes before the percent sign (42 %, DIN 5008)
German quotes hug their text: no space inside „…“
a label-ending ellipsis takes a no-break space before it (Wird geladen …, Einführung …), as macOS de writes it; a leading, range, or truncating … stays as is
a multiplier keeps the digit and takes a hyphen (4-mal), never 4x

hedges.why: a bracketed plural, case, or gender ending (Datei(en), jede(r)); use ICU plural/select, or rephrase
a slashed ending (Benutzer/in, ein/e; /s is the per-second unit and stays out); use ICU plural/select, or rephrase
a slashed article or pronoun hedging an unknown gender; repeat the noun (das Objekt) or rephrase
a gender star, colon, or Binnen-I; restructure to du or a neutral noun
